$comment: CANONICAL SUBSYSTEM PATH TAXONOMY. Owned by CRT (critic doctrine). This file is the single source of truth for the `judges:` values a reference item may claim and for the subsystem path a builder task may name. INDEX.md is GENERATED from this file + a scan of corpus/**/RI-*.md by tools/corpus-index.mjs. To add a path: append here (append-only; never renumber, never silently rename), then regenerate the index. A path that appears in an RI's `judges:` but not here is an ORPHAN and is reported by the generator.

arb_legend.souls: Inside the fight. Souls is authoritative (ARBITRATION.md §1).
arb_legend.morrowind: Outside the fight. Morrowind is authoritative (ARBITRATION.md §1).
arb_legend.modern-fidelity: Judged against current-generation graphics references ONLY (ARBITRATION.md §4).
arb_legend.art-direction: Judged against Morrowind / strangeness references ONLY (ARBITRATION.md §4).
arb_legend.split: A pre-decided seam. See the named seam ruling in ARBITRATION.md §2.
arb_legend.neutral: Neither side is authoritative; the corpus item defines the bar outright.

critics.critic.combat: Judges the fight. Must run the combat harness and read traces, never source.
critics.critic.progression: Judges levelling, economy, build identity, bonfires, equipment.
critics.critic.quests: Judges quest structure, faction escalation, resolution breadth.
critics.critic.dialogue: Judges topic graphs, disposition, rumours, NPC voice.
critics.critic.journal: Judges journal text as written, entry by entry.
critics.critic.world: Judges map, density, traversal, settlements, strangeness.
critics.critic.lore: Judges canon adherence, book structure, unreliable narration.
critics.critic.fidelity: Judges graphics quality against MODERN references only.
critics.critic.artdirection: Judges art direction against MORROWIND references only.
critics.critic.platform: Judges frame budget, load, input latency, persistence in a real browser.
critics.critic.coherence: End-of-wave whole-game agent. Fixes coherence, never quality. See COHERENCE-AGENT.md.
